_about: Every role in the platform. A role belongs to a module, is planned to use one login method, and is limited to a jurisdiction (city, ward or sector). 'built' marks roles with working screens. Login is a dummy for now: no PIN, password or OTP is checked.

roles.label: Surveyor
roles.description: Visits buildings and records building use, use mix and collection basics.

roles.label: Survey supervisor
roles.description: Assigns sectors, spot-checks surveys and resolves map problems.

roles.label: Planner
roles.description: Reads the waste profile and designs collection cycles, routes and transfer stations.

roles.label: Fleet and workforce manager
roles.description: Maintains the vehicle inventory, staff, shifts and PPE records.

roles.label: Driver
roles.description: Sees the assigned route and navigation, nothing more.

roles.label: Collector (pourakarmika)
roles.description: Starts the shift, confirms collection, and reports missed pickups, garbage vulnerable points and unsafe conditions.

roles.label: Operations supervisor
roles.description: Runs the live command centre, reassigns routes and validates penalties.

roles.label: MRF or DWCC operator
roles.description: Records incoming loads, sorting, rejects, downtime and incidents.

roles.label: Ward officer
roles.description: Sees coverage, bulk waste generators, compliance and analytics for the ward.

roles.label: Generator (household, RWA, BWG)
roles.description: Sees their building, schedule and status, and reports complaints.
